changes.title: Champion bot
items: A new bot to watch: pick "champion" in the bedroom's Player menu (or ?bot=champion). It's the skilled bot being trained overnight to play better

changes.title: Canopy depth trunks
items: Trees behind a fading crown no longer vanish: no more patches of forest drawn as flat green haze with no trunks, or canopy cut off along straight lines
Firs, cedars, willows and yews show their trunks under their low crowns, so a Norway forest on the ground has trunks again
Far-off and bent-away canopies no longer show thin horizontal lines across their leaves

changes.title: Legend throw visible
items: An angry legend's long-range throw now shows from the treetops: a ring closes round it, a line runs to where it's aiming and a ring marks where it'll land, then a glowing bomb arcs high over the trees
